description.value: Mr. Mike's is a Canadian steakhouse chain operating under the 'SteakhouseCasual' concept, serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, salads, and shareable appetizers in a casual, no-dress-code atmosphere. The Williams Lake location sits at 299 Oliver Street in the Cariboo region, making it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through this hub community on routes connecting the interior. With a full dine-in menu, online ordering, and takeout available, it can accommodate both a sit-down meal and a grab-and-go option.
